description_expanded: OverviewAmazing Location, 2 Bikes - Directly across the street from Public beach access! `Sidecar Apartment`The SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS : Less than 100 Steps to the Beach – Quick & easy access to the sand 0.75 Mile from Seaside – Bike or walk to shops & dining Wi-Fi Included – Stay connected during your getaway 2 Adult Bikes – Explore the scenic 30A area Driveway - 1 Car – Hassle-free parking Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest SupportWelcome to Sidecar ApartmentWelcome to Sidecar Apartment! In the heart of Seagrove, this studio apartment is all about location! Just a quick walk to the beach and a bike ride over to Seaside!This studio features a Queen sized bed, full bath with walk in shower, kitchenette, and cozy sofa with TV!*No garage accessHouse Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (2):Studio Apartment with Queen sized bedAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back. Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
